fundamentals.name: Lumentum Holdings Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates through two segments, Cloud & Networking and Industrial Tech. The Cloud & Networking segment offers optical and photonic chips, components, modules, and subsystems supplied to cloud data center operators, AI/ML infrastructure providers, and network equipment manufacturer customers that are building cloud data centers and network infrastructures. Its Industrial Tech segment provides short-pulse solid-state lasers, kilowatt-class fiber lasers, diode lasers, and gas lasers that serves the semiconductor device, solar cell, display, and electric vehicle and battery manufacturing markets. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.

positives: Revenue growth 90.1% YoY and analyst estimates for current Q and FY are exceptionally high.

Return on equity at 22.8% indicates efficient use of shareholder capital.
PEG ratio of 0.63 suggests growth may justify the current valuation.
Consensus 'buy' rating from 24 analysts with a mean target of $1113.01.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 159.64 and Forward P/E of 50.18 indicate a very high valuation.
Price/Sales (TTM) of 28.40 is also quite high.
Debt/Equity ratio of 111.44 and total debt exceeding total cash suggest leverage concerns.
Quick ratio of 0.94 indicates potential short-term liquidity challenges.
Beta of 1.48 suggests higher volatility than the broader market.

news.paragraph: Lumentum (LITE) saw its shares surge over 4% following a positive analyst report from J.P. Morgan suggesting it's time to buy the dip, and further gains were seen as optics stocks rode the AI boom. The company also recently strengthened its liquidity position, and its last reported quarter beat EPS estimates. While the stock has seen significant upside, analysts maintain a consensus 'buy' rating with a mean target of $1113.01.
